components.name: ChatComposer
components.doc: The message box on its own: autosizing text, attachments by button, paste, or drop, and a send button that morphs when there is something to send.

components.name: ChatThread
components.doc: A chat or support thread: grouped messages with day separators, reactions, read receipts that glide to the latest read message, a typing indicator, and a composer. The list stays pinned to the newest message and offers a pill when new messages land out of view.

members.name: avatar
members.doc: Portrait URL. Initials show when it is missing.

members.name: size
members.doc: Bytes.

members.name: width
members.doc: Intrinsic image size, used to reserve space before the image loads.

members.name: mine
members.doc: The current user reacted with this emoji.

members.name: status
members.doc: Delivery state of the current user's own messages.

types.name: ChatComposerLabels
types.doc: Words the composer shows or announces. Each has an English default.

members.name: send
members.doc: Accessible name of the send button.

members.name: attach
members.doc: Accessible name of the attach button.

members.name: attachments
members.doc: Accessible name of the list of files waiting to send.

members.name: removeFile
members.doc: Accessible name of the button that takes a file back out.

types.name: ChatThreadLabels
types.doc: Every word the thread shows or announces. Each has an English default; words with a count or names are functions, so an app can apply its own plural rules.

members.name: readBy
members.doc: Accessible name of the read receipts under a message.

members.name: today
members.doc: Day separators for the last two days. Older days are formatted by `locale`. Defaults come from Intl for `locale`.

members.name: typing
members.doc: Screen reader announcement of who is typing.

members.name: newMessages
members.doc: The pill when new messages land out of view. The count inside it rolls.

members.name: unknownAuthor
members.doc: Name shown for a message whose author is not in `participants`.

members.name: reactions
members.doc: Accessible name of the reaction picker and of the reactions under a message.

members.name: reactWith
members.doc: Accessible name of an emoji in the picker.

members.name: reactionCount
members.type: (emoji: string, count: number, includesYou: boolean) => string
members.doc: Accessible name of a reaction under a message.

members.name: messages
members.doc: Controlled messages, oldest first. Leave it out to let the thread keep its own list.

members.name: typing
members.doc: Participant ids currently typing.

members.name: readBy
members.doc: The last message each participant has read, by participant id. Their avatar sits under that message and glides as it moves.

members.name: onSend
members.doc: Called with the composer's text and files. Uncontrolled threads also append the message themselves.

members.name: reactions
members.doc: Emoji offered by the reaction picker.

members.name: composer
members.doc: Show the composer. Defaults to true.

members.name: accept
members.doc: File types the attach button offers, as for `<input accept>`.

members.name: groupWindow
members.doc: Messages from one person closer together than this, in ms, share a group. Defaults to five minutes.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the message log.

members.name: labels
members.doc: Words for localization. Leave out any key to keep its English default.

members.name: labels
members.doc: Words for localization. Leave out any key to keep its English default.
